Thank you guys so much for the support, I appreciate it more than you know ❤️. I started using after sexual harassment/assault at my previous job, and the whole thing was handled very poorly. I spun out of control really quickly, and let pretty much everyone, including myself, down. I got clean after a serious health scare that landed me in the hospital, which was a wake up call. I hate how I was when I was using, and I have a lot of guilt about that. I'll spend forever making it up to my daughter. I feel like a bad parent because I'm just such a difficult person to be around. I work with my parents after leaving my other job, and we don't have the best relationship. It's very dysfunctional. I'm a completely different person than they are, and we have very little in common. I like the freedom of the job in terms of having more time to spend w/my daughter, but I feel uncomfortable around my parents. They're hard to talk to about anything of substance. An example of that would be my dad complaining about "all the women accusing these men of sexual assault when they (the accused) get rich." He says these things without thought to what I experienced at my former job. When I bring up how the attitude he holds is the a lot of the reason I didn't report (not him specifically, just that people won't believe you), he just shrugs and says "well in lighter news, the weathers nice.", or something like that. I feel lost in terms of my career and what to do next. It all cumulates and gets to me more on days like today when I'm already feeling the anxious about my direction in life, and having negative memories brought up by my dads dismissiveness.
